items: Start with the bottleneck costing you the most money, such as slow ticket times, labor waste or few repeat guests, before buying any new technology.
Your POS is the hub of your stack, and its sales data feeds menu engineering, labor productivity, cash control and your financials.
Make sure your POS, online ordering, kitchen display, loyalty and accounting systems connect, because double-entering data wastes time and adds errors.
Choose tools built for restaurants, and weigh third-party delivery fees and the guest data you give up against the reach those apps add.
With a limited marketing budget, focus on plenty of positive reviews on your Google Business Profile and location pages that rank in your local area.
